title: Executor: classify quota_exhausted and runner_error from runner evidence at collect
description: Follow-up from qg5 (DONE_WITH_CONCERNS). contracts/job-protocol.json defines a quota_exhausted failure class so a flat-rate seat running out of quota is not reported as a broken route; today a codex run that hits its usage limit collects as no-commits / runner_error. Add a failure-class hint derived from the runner's exit and its log tail (diagnostic material only — never a completion signal): codex 'You have hit your usage limit' / claude and pi equivalents -> quota_exhausted; unknown flag or usage error (exit 2) -> a distinct configuration class per the contract vocabulary; otherwise runner_error. Golden a codex usage-limit log captured on 2026-09-02 as a fixture. Scope: internal/exec/subprocess only (collect.go, report/vocabulary tests). Do not touch internal/reconcile (built concurrently by px2) or any other package. Read RESULT of qg5 in git history and lifecycle_test.go before starting.
acceptance_criteria: A fake-runner test that exits 1 with the codex usage-limit text collects with failure class quota_exhausted; a fake exiting 2 with a usage error collects with the contract's configuration class; the classes used exist in contracts/job-protocol.json (asserted by test); go test -short ./internal/exec/... green
